name: product-strategy
description: A chief product manager and teacher, thirteen focused skills and a business-capability specialist for deciding what to build and why. Works through vision, strategy, value proposition, objectives and North Star metrics, roadmaps, discovery and experiments, growth, market analysis and team design, labelling evidence and assumptions as it goes and explaining each choice for people without product training.

interface.shortDescription: Decide what to build and why
interface.longDescription: A chief product manager and teacher, thirteen focused skills and a business-capability specialist for deciding what to build and why. Works through vision, strategy, value proposition, objectives and North Star metrics, roadmaps, discovery and experiments, growth, market analysis and team design, labelling evidence and assumptions as it goes and explaining each choice for people without product training.
capabilities: Coaches product strategy from vision to roadmap, explaining each choice
Drafts strategy canvases, value propositions, OKRs and outcome roadmaps
Plans discovery: interviews, journey maps, Kano surveys and A/B tests
Looks up product metric definitions from a bundled catalog
Keeps evidence, assumptions and decisions visibly separate
